# Test JSON discriminator detection and badge rendering.

md2html -html output -html-ext html -jsonspec-prefixes ascf/ -jsonspec-badge-url 'schemas.html#%s' -jsonspec-badge-label '%s schema' testsite
exists output/README.html

# Discriminator block gets wrapping div with data-schema-type.
grep 'class="md-jsonspec" data-schema-type="hypothesis"' output/README.html

# Badge anchor links to the schema page using the URL template.
grep 'class="md-jsonspec-badge" href="schemas.html#hypothesis"' output/README.html
grep 'hypothesis schema</a>' output/README.html

# Plain JSON (no discriminator) stays untouched.
! grep 'data-schema-type="plain"' output/README.html

# Non-JSON fence with a matching value is not enriched.
! grep 'data-schema-type="go"' output/README.html

# Different prefix is ignored.
! grep 'data-schema-type="foo"' output/README.html

# Chroma highlighting still runs; the outer div wraps chroma's <pre>.
grep 'class="chroma"' output/README.html

rm -rf testsite output

-- testsite/README.md --
# ASCF Examples

Hypothesis example:

```json
{
  "type": "ascf/hypothesis",
  "id": "h1",
  "iteration": 1
}
```

Plain JSON, no discriminator:

```json
{
  "id": "plain"
}
```

Go block with a red-herring type field:

```go
m := map[string]string{"type": "ascf/hypothesis"}
```

Different prefix, not enabled:

```json
{
  "type": "example/foo"
}
```
